training_profile.note: Heuristic support check, not a validated distribution-shift detector.

import_notices: Nessie sandbox snapshot; restart the API to refresh balances and history.
Internal transfers, credit-card activity and cash withdrawals are excluded from cash-spending history.
Loan balances require explicit confirmed outstanding principal; original loan amounts are not assumed to be current debt.
Loan payment dates must be supplied as bills; loan monthly_payment alone is not a payment calendar.

Checking deposits are shown as inflows, not verified salary. Unmapped purchases use category other. Map historical scheduled-bill payments to fixed categories to avoid double counting them in variable spending. Card and savings activity are excluded from spending totals.
limitations: One configured synthetic customer, not a representative independent customer cohort.
Category mappings do not prove completeness. Account balances cannot be backtested from an incomplete movement ledger.
No model or threshold is selected from these outcomes; fallback remains unvalidated for real customer use.
